title: Bapat–Lal's Soules-type conjecture for the μ-permanent
statement: Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Hermitian positive semidefinite matrix, let $\Pi_\mu(A)$ be its μ-Schur power matrix, and let $\mu\in[0,1]$. **Bapat–Lal's conjecture.** The largest eigenvalue of $\Pi_\mu(A)$ is $P_\mu(A)$. This extends Soules' conjecture to the μ-permanent setting. The source attributes the extension to Bapat and Lal and does not report a general resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.02231

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2018).
source_name: Carlos M. da Fonseca, “The μ-permanent revisited”, arXiv:1804.02231 (2018).
